summary: For groups of 2-4 PIs with complementary skills to tackle ambitious research problems. Up to €10M for 6 years (+€4M for relocation/equipment). 2026 round received record 957 proposals. 2027 round RESCHEDULED: opening moved to February 2027, deadline May 2027 (confirmed by ERC). Bottom-up: any research topic. Stricter resubmission restrictions in 2027. Excellent fit for cross-disciplinary pharmacoepi/HTA/data science collaborations.

name: Joint EPHAR–EACPT Young Investigator Awards in Translational Pharmacology
themes: Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics
partnersNote: EACPT or EPHAR affiliation
summary: Two awards of €1,000 each for young scientists with an outstanding translational pharmacology publication in the preceding two years. Awarded at the EACPT Congress; 2025 awards presented in Helsinki. Next EACPT Congress cycle expected 2027. Fits clinical pharmacology PhDs and early-career postdocs.

name: FIP / IPSF Early-Career Congress Grant (FIP 2027)
themes: Education & training
partnersNote: ECPG or IPSF membership
summary: Up to €1,500 per awardee toward transport, accommodation and registration for the FIP World Congress of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences. Targeted at ECPG / IPSF members. The 2026 Montreal round has closed; the 2027 congress-grant page is not yet live, deadline expected spring 2027 (TBC).

name: Pathways to Sustainability Incubator Grants 2027
careerStages: Postdoc; Early career; Mid career; Senior/PI
themes: Sustainable pharmacy & planetary health; Open (any discipline)
partnersNote: Active UU scholars from multiple disciplines and at least two faculties; external partners optional
summary: Annual UU Pathways to Sustainability grant for interdisciplinary teams (UU scholars from at least two faculties, external partners welcome) to build a community and develop a new sustainability idea over 12 months. Teams get up to €8,000, paid in two tranches; at most five grants a year, and awardees must attend a Kickstarter workshop. Incubator teams can later apply for a Signature Project Grant (from 2027 up to three a year, max €125,000 each). PtS expects the next round in spring 2027. The date shown is estimated from the 2026 deadline (20 May 2026).

name: ICRPA 2027 – International Cardiovascular Research Partnership Awards (expected)
themes: Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Drug safety & pharmacovigilance
partnersNote: At least 3 independent mid-career PIs from different participating countries (France, Germany, Netherlands, Spain, UK)
summary: Joint call from the BHF, Dutch Heart Foundation, DZHK, Lefoulon-Delalande Foundation, CNIC and CIBER-CV for future leaders in cardiovascular research. Each project is co-led by at least three independent mid-career PIs in different participating countries, and each funder pays its own country's share (up to €/£500,000 each, €400,000 for DZHK) for up to 4 years. The 2026 round (the 8th) closed 27 May 2026. A 2027 round has not been announced, so the deadline is estimated and is not confirmed.

name: ZonMw Open Competition M – Mid-Career Pilot (2027)
themes: Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics; Drug safety & pharmacovigilance; HTA & health economics
summary: ZonMw pilot Open Competition M (OC-M) for mid-career researchers doing independent, curiosity-driven fundamental (bio)medical research in any discipline; max EUR 400,000 per project. The first round opens in spring 2027 (pilot rounds in 2027 and 2029, alternating with OC-L), with the call text expected in early 2027. Deadline not yet known. The date shown is a placeholder for the end of spring 2027 until ZonMw publishes the call.

name: NNF Project Grants in Endocrinology & Metabolism 2027
themes: Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Drug safety & pharmacovigilance; Drug utilisation & appropriate use
summary: Novo Nordisk Foundation project grants for basic, clinical and translational research in endocrinology and metabolism: up to DKK 4.5M over 1–3 years (max DKK 1.5M per year); the 2026 round had a DKK 103M pool, with DKK 11M earmarked for hormone regulation in women's health. The main applicant must be an experienced independent researcher at a non-profit institution in Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway or Sweden; co-applicants are not allowed and salary for the grantee is not covered. The 2026 call ran 8 April–4 June 2026, and the next call is expected in April 2027. Relevant via Nordic collaborators for diabetes/cardiometabolic drug research.

name: ACPE 2026 Melbourne – Travel Scholarships
themes: Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Drug safety & pharmacovigilance
summary: ISPE travel scholarships to attend the Asian Conference on Pharmacoepidemiology (ACPE), useful for early-career pharmacoepidemiologists who want to present and network in the Asia-Pacific region. The 18th ACPE takes place 30 Oct–1 Nov 2026 in Melbourne; its scholarship round (deadline 12 Jun 2026) has closed. ISPE has not yet announced a 2027 ACPE host or dates, so the June 2027 deadline is an estimate based on the 2026 cycle.

name: KNAW Van Walree Fund 2027
themes: Open (any discipline)
summary: KNAW fund of up to €10,000 for medical scientific researchers in medical, biomedical or health sciences at a university or research institute in the Kingdom of the Netherlands. Since 2023 it supports sustainable, innovative and internationally accessible knowledge sharing between medical researchers. The 2027 round opens 15 March 2027; KNAW has not yet published the closing date, so 15 June 2027 is estimated from the 2026 deadline (15 Jun 2026).

name: EULAR-ACR Research Exchange Programme 2027
themes: Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence
summary: Reciprocal short exchange between EULAR and the American College of Rheumatology: selected early-career rheumatology researchers join the partner society's congress and a structured institution visit/workshop. European applicants apply via EULAR and need a non-tenured faculty post (assistant professor or below) in a EULAR country; they receive a travel stipend (amount not published) and pay any other costs. The 2024 European call closed 19 June 2024 for a November exchange in the US. ACR says details for the 2027 programme are still to be announced. Useful for building transatlantic networks on DMARD/biologic safety research.

name: ZonMw GGG – Extramurale Farmaceutische Zorg Ronde 2 (expected 2027)
careerStages: Postdoc; Early career; Mid career; Senior/PI
themes: Pharmacy practice & clinical pharmacy; Drug utilisation & appropriate use; Implementation & health services
partnersNote: Collaboration between primary-care parties encouraged (round 1)
summary: Expected second round of the GGG 'Extramurale Farmaceutische Zorg' call (primary-care pharmaceutical care: pharmacists, GPs, district nursing, social domain). ZonMw lists opening 'first half 2027'. Round 1 (opened 18 Dec 2025, deadline 3 Mar 2026) had €5.41M; phase 1 pilots up to €125k/12 mo, phase 2 practice evaluations up to €320k/24 mo. Deadline is a placeholder; not yet announced.

name: ZonMw GGG – Vrouwspecifieke farmacotherapie (female-specific pharmacotherapy, expected 2027)
careerStages: Postdoc; Early career; Mid career; Senior/PI
themes: Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Drug safety & pharmacovigilance
summary: New GGG round on female-specific pharmacotherapy announced as expected, opening first half 2027. No budget or deadline yet published; deadline is a placeholder pending the call text.

name: ZonMw GGG – Dosisoptimalisatiestudies (dose-optimisation studies, expected 2027)
careerStages: Postdoc; Early career; Mid career; Senior/PI
themes: Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics; Clinical trials & drug development; HTA & health economics
summary: New GGG round for dose-optimisation studies (e.g. lower/alternative dosing of existing drugs), expected to open first half 2027. No budget or deadline published yet; deadline is a placeholder.

name: KNAW Early Career Award 2027
themes: Open (any discipline)
summary: KNAW Early Career Award: up to 12 awards per year (max. 3 per Academy domain) of €15,000 plus a work of art, for researchers 3–7 years post-PhD who do not yet hold an associate/full professor or equivalent position. Candidates must be nominated by KNAW/Young Academy members, full professors at a Dutch university or directors of Dutch research institutes. The 2027 nomination round opens 1 April 2027; the closing date is not yet published, so 1 July 2027 is estimated from the 2026 round (1 Jul 2026).

name: Longfonds-Swierenga Grant 2027 – Rare Lung Disease Research
themes: Rare diseases & orphan drugs; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence
summary: Up to EUR 50,000 for a one-year project by an early-career researcher (PhD or confirmed defence date; also clinicians/nurses with research track record) at a Dutch institution, on rare pulmonary diseases only (asthma, COPD and lung cancer excluded). Longfonds states the 2027 call opens in April 2027 (offered annually 2025-2029); the deadline shown is projected from the 2026 round (3 Jul 2026) and not confirmed.

name: Longfonds Junior Investigator Grant 2027 (expected)
themes: Drug safety & pharmacovigilance; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence
summary: Longfonds Junior Investigator Grants: in 2026 three grants of up to €250,000 over three years (one CPBT grant linked to Ombion's Asthma & COPD transition project) for researchers within five years of their PhD. Two-stage procedure (pre-application, then full proposal); patient involvement is required. The 2026 round closed (full proposals due 14 Jul 2026, awards 16 Dec 2026); no 2027 round is announced, so 14 Jul 2027 is estimated from the 2026 full-proposal deadline, with a pre-application stage expected in spring.

name: Science for Industry Call 2027
themes: Valorisation & public-private; Clinical trials & drug development; Open (any discipline)
partnersNote: Min. 1 Dutch for-profit company (lead applicant) + 1 Dutch research organisation; co-financing required
summary: Health~Holland PPP call for collaborations led by a Dutch company with at least one Dutch research organisation; the 2026 round offered at least EUR 5M in total and EUR 0.5-1.2M PPP subsidy per project, with mandatory pre-registration. A 2027 round has not been announced; the date shown is projected from the 2026 pre-registration (14 Jul 2026; full application 22 Sep 2026) and is not confirmed.

name: Prix Galien Bridges 2027 – Nordic+ Innovation Awards (incl. Netherlands)
themes: Clinical trials & drug development
summary: Galien Foundation awards recognising biopharma and medtech innovation in the Nordic countries and five 'Nordics+' partner markets, including the Netherlands. Categories include Best Biotech & Pharma Product, Best Medical Technology/AI, Best Product for Rare/Orphan Diseases, Best Public Sector Innovation, Best Bridge-Builder Institution and (from 2026) Best Enabling Technology; it honours products and institutions and no cash prize is stated. The 2026 nomination deadline was extended to 15 Sep 2026 (ceremony 1 Dec 2026, Stockholm); the 2027 cycle is not announced, so the July 2027 date is an estimate based on the original 2026 deadline.

name: Open Competition Domain Science – M 2026/2027
themes: Open (any discipline); Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics; Data science & AI
summary: NWO's continuous open competition for curiosity-driven research in the Science domain. The 2026/2027 round was expected to open in August 2026 and closes when 420 proposals are reached (assessed in five packages) or at the latest on 31 July 2027; new restrictions apply to applicants with ongoing NWO/ZonMw projects. In the previous round grants were up to EUR 400k (single applicant) or EUR 800k (with co-applicant); verify current amounts on the call page.

name: KNAW Van Leersum Beurs (research visit abroad – pharmacy/neurology/radiology)
themes: Pharmacy practice & clinical pharmacy
partnersNote: Host at a foreign university/institute
summary: KNAW Van Leersum Grant for a working visit to a foreign university or institute by PhD candidates or researchers within four years of their PhD in pharmacy, neurology or radiology, applying from a Dutch university. The 2026 round closed 3 August 2026. The 2027 round opens 1 May 2027; the closing date is not yet published, so 3 August 2027 is estimated from the 2026 deadline.

name: RECRUIT Programme 2027 – International Recruitment Grants (expected)
themes: Open (any discipline); Data science & AI; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence
summary: Novo Nordisk Foundation RECRUIT grants (up to DKK 55M for up to 7 years) to recruit outstanding international researchers to Danish universities, with separate Sabbatical (DKK 1M, 1 year) and Extension (DKK 10M, 5 years) grants. Candidates must be nominated by the recruiting Danish university, so this is not open to Utrecht-based applicants directly. The 2026 call (opened 5 May 2026) closed 12 Aug 2026; the 12 Aug 2027 date is estimated from that cycle.

name: NNF RECRUIT – Grants for International Recruitment 2027
themes: Open (any discipline); Data science & AI; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence
summary: RECRUIT grants (up to DKK 55M over up to 7 years) help Danish universities recruit international researchers at assistant, associate or full professor level; Sabbatical (up to DKK 1M) and Extension (up to DKK 10M) grants are part of the same call. Universities nominate candidates within a quota, and only nominees apply; the scope is natural and technical sciences, interdisciplinary research, and biotechnology/sustainability, so health research fits poorly. The 2026 call ran 5 May–12 August 2026 (the 2025 call closed 4 March 2025), and NNF says calls recur but has not published 2027 dates.

name: ERC Advanced Grant 2027
themes: Open (any discipline); Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics
summary: ERC Advanced Grant 2027 (Work Programme 2027) for established research leaders with a strong track record, in any field, hosted in an EU Member State or associated country. Up to €2.5M over 5 years, plus up to €1M for start-up costs/major equipment and up to €2M extra for PIs moving from a non-associated third country. Call opens 27 May 2027; deadline 26 August 2027. Successor to the 2026 round (ID 25).

name: FIP Foundation & ECPG Innovation Research Grant
themes: Pharmacy practice & clinical pharmacy; Open (any discipline); Drug utilisation & appropriate use
summary: FIP Foundation and Early Career Pharmaceutical Group grant of €1,000 to implement an innovative project, plus complimentary registration, return airfare and hotel for the next FIP World Congress once a project report is accepted. Open to early-career pharmacists and pharmaceutical scientists who are ECPG members, in any field of pharmacy with a focus on innovation in practice or clinically applicable science. FIP Foundation lists applications as open, but no closing date is published; the 2027-09-01 date is a placeholder.

name: Nierstichting–Health~Holland PPS Call (last round 2024)
themes: Drug safety & pharmacovigilance; Valorisation & public-private; Clinical trials & drug development; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence
partnersNote: Public-private partnership required with industry partner
summary: Joint Nierstichting and Health~Holland call for public-private kidney research projects (TRL4+) fitting the KIA 2024–2027 Health & Care missions. The 2024 round had €1.4M for two projects (max €500k PPS subsidy + €200k Nierstichting cash each), with pre-proposals due 12 Jun 2024 and full proposals by invitation. No 2025, 2026 or 2027 round has been announced; the 2027-09-01 date is a placeholder.

name: Veni – Science Domain 2027
themes: Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics; Open (any discipline)
summary: NWO Veni gives up to €320,000 for 3 years to researchers who obtained their PhD within roughly the last three years, to develop their own research line. The 2026 Science-domain round closed for pre-proposals on 1 September 2026; full proposals are due 26 January 2027 (invited applicants only), and a pilot with an expanded research-idea section is in its second run. The next (2027) round is expected to follow the same annual cycle, with pre-proposals around 1 September 2027; NWO has not yet published dates. For pharmacoepidemiology, the ZonMw-domain Veni may be the better fit.

name: ERC Plus Grant 2027
themes: Open (any discipline); Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics
summary: Second round of the ERC Plus Grant: up to €7M per project for transformative, high-ambition research, open to PIs at any career stage. ERC Work Programme 2027 gives ERC-2027-PLUS a provisional opening of 1 June 2027 and a deadline of 1 September 2027, with a budget of €210M and about 30 grants.

name: EU4Health 2027 Work Programme – Action Grants incl. Conference Grants (expected)
themes: Pharmaceutical policy & access; Implementation & health services; Drug utilisation & appropriate use
summary: The Commission is preparing the EU4Health 2027 work programme, the last under the 2021-2027 programme. A targeted consultation ran until 12 June 2026 around five strands: crisis preparedness, health promotion and prevention, health systems and workforce, digital transformation, and cancer, cardiovascular and other NCDs. Calls, including the recurring high-level conference grants, are expected in 2027. No calls or dates are published yet, so the deadline is an estimate.

name: Exploratory Interdisciplinary Synergy Programme 2027 (expected)
themes: Open (any discipline); Data science & AI; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Sustainable pharmacy & planetary health
partnersNote: Interdisciplinary team required
summary: Novo Nordisk Foundation call with an annual budget of DKK 68M, granting up to DKK 6.8M per project for up to 3 years for exploratory interdisciplinary research within Biomedical Sciences, Biotechnology or Natural/Technical Sciences with health or sustainability applicability. Projects are based in Denmark. The 2026 call (opened 12 Mar 2026) closed 3 Sep 2026; the next call is expected to open in March 2027, and the 3 Sep 2027 deadline is estimated from the 2026 cycle.

name: MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships 2027
themes: Open (any discipline); Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics
summary: Annual MSCA call for individual European and Global Postdoctoral Fellowships for researchers with a PhD, under the MSCA 2026-2027 work programme. A draft of that work programme (Nov 2025) lists HORIZON-MSCA-2027-PF-01 as opening 7 April 2027 with a deadline of 8 September 2027 and about €389M indicative budget. These dates are not yet confirmed on an official call page.

name: GGG – Goed Gebruik Geneesmiddelen Open Ronde 17 (2027)
themes: Drug utilisation & appropriate use; Drug safety & pharmacovigilance; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Medication adherence & self-management
partnersNote: Collaboration with patient representatives, healthcare professionals and/or insurers expected (per previous rounds)
summary: Open round of ZonMw's Good Use of Medicines programme, funding research on better, safer and more efficient medicine use. Open Ronde 16 had EUR 6M in total and up to EUR 1.5M per project, with a project-idea deadline of 14 Sep 2026 and full proposals on 2 Mar 2027. A next open round has not been announced; the project-idea deadline shown is projected (previous + 1 year) and is not confirmed.

name: NNF Distinguished Innovator Grant 2027
themes: Clinical trials & drug development; Open (any discipline); Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Data science & AI; Valorisation & public-private
summary: Up to DKK 7.6M over 3 years for senior researchers with a proven innovation track record (patents, spin-outs) to move research-based innovations in health or sustainability towards use. The applicant must work at a non-profit research institution or hospital in a Nordic country; co-applicants may be abroad. The 2026 call ran 1 Aug–15 Sep 2026, and from 2027 the grant is awarded once a year, with the next call planned for autumn 2027. Relevant only via Nordic-based partners.

name: Open Competition Domain Science – XL 2027/2028 (expected)
themes: Open (any discipline); Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics; Data science & AI
partnersNote: Consortium project
summary: NWO's Domain Science XL call for large consortium projects across all Domain Science disciplines, including Life Sciences. NWO says the call runs once every two years, and the 2025/2026 round had a pre-proposal deadline of 16 September 2025. The next round has not been announced, so the pre-proposal deadline is estimated two years after the last one and is not confirmed. The budget range shown comes from the previous round.

name: HORIZON-HLTH-2027-03-TOOL-04 – Virtual Human Twins for Clinical Decision Support in Prevention and Diagnosis
themes: Data science & AI; Precision medicine & pharmacogenetics; HTA & health economics
diseaseAreas: Cardiovascular; Oncology; Diabetes & metabolic; Infectious disease
partnersNote: Multidisciplinary consortium; SSH contribution mandatory; SME participation encouraged.
summary: Research and Innovation Action to build and clinically validate multi-scale, patient-specific Virtual Human Twin models that support prevention and diagnosis, including health-economic or cost-effectiveness evidence from real-world settings and plans for regulatory compliance (MDR/IVDR, AI Act). Expected EU contribution is €10–12 million per project (about 4 projects). The single-stage call opens 3 June 2027 and closes 16 September 2027.

name: HORIZON-HLTH-2027-03-TOOL-08 – Next Generation of Frontier AI Models for Healthcare (CSA)
themes: Data science & AI
partnersNote: Horizon Europe CSA consortium.
summary: Coordination and Support Action (a single project of around €2.9 million) on preparing the next generation of frontier AI models for healthcare. The single-stage call opens 3 June 2027 and closes 16 September 2027. The detailed scope was not read, so check the work programme.

name: Mission Cancer 2027 – CANCER-04 Health-Economics, Health-Systems & Outcomes Research for Equitable Cancer Outcomes
themes: HTA & health economics; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Implementation & health services; Pharmaceutical policy & access
partnersNote: Horizon Europe consortium; must build on Knowledge Centre on Cancer resources (ECIS, Cancer Inequalities Registry).
summary: Research and Innovation Action (HORIZON-MISS-2027-02-CANCER-04) to develop health-economics, health-systems, epidemiological and outcomes-research methods for cancer. Funded work covers cost-effectiveness modelling, cancer-control spending linked to value-based care, inequalities, and better access to cost-effective programmes. Expected EU contribution is €5–7 million per project (about 3 projects). The call opens 10 February 2027 with a deadline of 16 September 2027 (FFG lists 15 September), and projects must join the Mission's 'Understanding' cluster.

name: Dr. Saal van Zwanenberg Afstudeerprijzen 2027 (pharmaceutical master thesis)
themes: Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics; Pharmacy practice & clinical pharmacy; Education & training
partnersNote: Nomination (voordracht) required
summary: Three annual KHMW prizes (EUR 3,000 / 2,000 / 1,000) for the best master research reports in pharmaceutical and/or medical sciences in which medicines are central, for graduates of Dutch research universities. Entries are submitted as nominations via the KHMW prize portal. The current round closed 17 Sep 2026; the next date shown is projected (+1 year) and not confirmed.

name: Leopold Meijler Prijs 2027 (best student thesis – drug safety)
themes: Drug safety & pharmacovigilance; Education & training
summary: Annual prize (cash amount plus a ceramic artwork) for the best bachelor's or master's thesis or article on medication safety by a Medicine, Pharmacy or Health Sciences student at a Dutch university. Submissions go by e-mail to Lareb before 1 October; the 2027 edition has not been separately announced, so the date is based on this standing annual deadline.

name: Young Investigator Grant (YIG) Call 2028
themes: Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Clinical trials & drug development
summary: Annual KWF call for early-career cancer researchers (PhD at most 5 years before the deadline) to start an independent research line, with up to EUR 1M per project (about 4 years). The 2028 round has not been announced yet; the deadline shown is projected from the 2027 round (pre-proposal 6 Oct 2026, full proposal 1 Apr 2027) and is not confirmed.

name: NWA-ORC 2027 – Research along Routes by Consortia
themes: Pharmaceutical policy & access; Implementation & health services; HTA & health economics; Open (any discipline)
partnersNote: Inter- and transdisciplinary consortium incl. societal (public/private) partners; workshop participation required in 2026 round
summary: Dutch Research Agenda (NWA) call for large inter- and transdisciplinary consortia with societal partners tackling NWA questions; the 2026 round had EUR 87M in total and up to EUR 7.25M per proposal for 4-8 years, with mandatory workshops beforehand. A 2027 round has not been announced; the deadline shown is projected from the 2026 round (6 Oct 2026) and is not confirmed.

name: ERA-AD 2028 – European Research Academy on Alzheimer's Disease
themes: Education & training; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence
summary: ERA-AD (formerly the European Alzheimer Academy Workshop) is a five-day academy for early-career dementia researchers, combining science lectures with training in grant writing, career planning and networking. It is run jointly by Alzheimer Forschung Initiative, Alzheimer Nederland, Fondation Vaincre Alzheimer and Synapsis Foundation; each partner selects about 10 participants from its own country (advanced PhD students and young postdocs). The 2026 edition took place 1–5 March 2026 (applications closed 11 November 2025), and the next edition is planned for 2028. This is a training academy with travel support, not consortium research funding.

name: WHO Consultancy & Research Contracts
themes: Pharmaceutical policy & access; Global health
summary: WHO regularly commissions research on access to medicines, pharmaceutical policy, essential medicines lists, and regulatory systems. The division already has WHO CC status. Check WHO procurement portal.

name: EMA Framework Contracts & Tenders
themes: Regulatory science; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Drug safety & pharmacovigilance
summary: EMA publishes calls for tenders on the EU Funding & Tenders Portal and in the Official Journal (TED); open procedures are used from about EUR 140,000, smaller contracts via negotiated procedures. The division already has a framework contract with EMA. Monitor the EMA procurement page for new tenders and ex ante notices.

name: ISPE Awards (annual call for nominations)
careerStages: PhD; Postdoc; Early career; Mid career; Senior/PI
themes: Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Drug safety & pharmacovigilance
summary: ISPE runs an annual call for nominations for recognition awards, including the Emerging Leader Award (2–7 years membership, within 5 years of terminal degree), the Sustained Scientific Excellence Award and Lecture ($1,000 honorarium plus travel), the Judith K. Jones Award and service awards. Student abstract awards (Edlavitch, McAfee, John Snow) are given at ISPE meetings. Most awards bring a plaque and a waived registration fee, not research funding, and the nomination deadlines are not published on the awards pages.

name: FIP Research & Education Grants
careerStages: PhD; Postdoc; Early career; Mid career; Senior/PI
themes: Pharmacy practice & clinical pharmacy; Pharmaceutical policy & access; Education & training
summary: The FIP Foundation for Education and Research offers small grants, fellowships and travel scholarships. Current schemes include the ECPG Innovation Grant (early-career members), the FIP Foundation–BPS grant on the impact of pharmacist board certification (up to €5,000; the 2026 grant was awarded in August 2026) and the FIP Hospital Pharmacy Section research grant on implementing the Basel Statements. Amounts and deadlines are not published on the main Foundation page, so monitor the individual calls.

name: Grand Challenges – Global Health
careerStages: PhD; Postdoc; Early career; Mid career; Senior/PI
themes: Global health; Pharmaceutical policy & access
summary: Various calls for innovative solutions to global health challenges. Relevant for division's work on access to medicines in LMICs and global pharmaceutical policy.

name: ZIN Research Commissions & Collaboration
themes: HTA & health economics; Pharmaceutical policy & access; Pharmacy practice & clinical pharmacy
summary: Zorginstituut Nederland regularly commissions research to support its quality and benefits-package tasks, for example effectiveness studies of reimbursed care. Tenders are issued through a Dynamic Purchasing System (DAS) on Mercell: research groups register free on Mercell and request qualification to join the DAS, after which they can respond to individual research questions. Contract values and deadlines are set per tender.

name: MEB Research Commissions
themes: Regulatory science; Drug safety & pharmacovigilance; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Pharmaceutical policy & access
summary: The Dutch Medicines Evaluation Board (CBG-MEB) runs its own regulatory science programme (Science Policy 2025-2029) and works with academic groups, other knowledge institutes, EMA and public-private programmes such as RSNN, Horizon Europe and IMI. Its Commissie Wetenschap decides which studies CBG takes part in and which qualify for funding, and PhD candidates can do research embedded at CBG. CBG does not publish an open call, budget or tender procedure for commissioned research, so collaboration is by direct contact; the division already has an MEB relationship.

name: Novo Nordisk Foundation – Health Research Grants
themes: Global health; Antimicrobial resistance & One Health; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Drug utilisation & appropriate use
summary: Umbrella entry for the Novo Nordisk Foundation's open-competition grants (project grants, research leader and investigator grants, fellowships, collaborative programmes) in health, sustainability and life science. Individual calls have their own deadlines throughout the year and most require a host institution in Denmark/the Nordic region. Check the 'Apply for grants' overview for calls open to Dutch researchers.

name: EU4Health 2026 Work Programme – Upcoming Action Grants
themes: Pharmaceutical policy & access; HTA & health economics; Data science & AI
partnersNote: Eligible entities from EU member states or associated countries
summary: This is a monitoring entry for EU4Health action grants run by HaDEA. The last batch of action grants (EU4H-2026-SANTE-PJ, under the 2025 Work Programme) included topics on AI/health data for cardiovascular disease, a medicine pricing, reimbursement and access tracker (EURIPID), and EHDS health data for biotech; it opened 23 Sep 2025 and closed 6 Jan 2026. No new calls under a 2026 Work Programme were found on HaDEA as of Oct 2026. A stakeholder consultation for the 2027 Work Programme ran until 12 Jun 2026. Watch HaDEA and the EU Funding & Tenders portal for new topics.

name: Wellcome Career Development Awards – Always-Open (rolling)
themes: Open (any discipline); Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Drug safety & pharmacovigilance
summary: Since 25 August 2026, Wellcome Career Development Awards are always open with no submission deadlines. Shortlisting happens three times a year (Feb, Jun, Sep) and interviews three times a year (the deadlines page lists May 2027 and Sep 2027 interview rounds). The award is for mid-career researchers ready to lead their own programme: it covers salary and research costs, typically under GBP 250k per year excluding salary, for usually 8 years. Important: the administering organisation must be in the UK, Republic of Ireland or an LMIC (excluding India and mainland China), and from 29 Oct 2026 only the UK and LMICs in Africa, South Asia and South-East Asia, so Utrecht-based researchers are not eligible as lead applicants.

name: KNMP Proefschrift-bijdrage (dissertation publication contribution)
themes: Pharmacy practice & clinical pharmacy
summary: Each year the Stichting KNMP-fondsen gives 15-25 PhD candidates a contribution toward publishing a dissertation whose research the board considers valuable for pharmacy practice. The contribution also covers publishing the main findings in the Pharmaceutisch Weekblad. Apply at any time with the KNMP-fondsen application form (contact knmpfondsen@knmp.nl). The page states no amount or deadline.

name: ESCP Research Grant & Fellowship
themes: Pharmacy practice & clinical pharmacy; Drug safety & pharmacovigilance; Drug utilisation & appropriate use
partnersNote: Study must involve partners in at least two European countries; applicant must be an ESCP member
summary: The European Society of Clinical Pharmacy issues periodic calls for its Research Grant, open to ESCP members for projects of up to 24 months involving at least two European countries; any design is allowed and results are published in the International Journal of Clinical Pharmacy. The ESCP Fellowship (FESCP) is honorary recognition by nomination, without funding. No grant amount or call dates are published on ESCP's pages; calls and the annual fellowship deadline are communicated to members.

name: Leopold Meijler Fonds – PhD Dissertation Support (Drug Safety)
themes: Drug safety & pharmacovigilance
summary: The Leopold Meijler Fonds at Lareb contributes to printing costs for dissertations by PhD candidates at Dutch universities or hbo institutions, for theses with several chapters on adverse drug reactions, organisation or methods of pharmacovigilance, or education on these topics. Apply any time before printing by emailing E.P. van Puijenbroek a short motivation with the title page, table of contents and summary; a reply is aimed for within 4 weeks. Already-printed theses are not considered, and the fund must be acknowledged in the dissertation. This is separate from the annual Leopold Meijler student prize (ID 152).

name: Wellcome Early-Career Awards – Always-Open (rolling)
themes: Open (any discipline); Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Drug safety & pharmacovigilance
summary: Since 25 August 2026, Wellcome Early-Career Awards are always open with no submission deadlines. Shortlisting happens three times a year (Feb, Jun, Sep) and interviews three times a year (the deadlines page lists May 2027 and Sep 2027 interview rounds). The award covers salary plus up to GBP 400,000 research expenses, usually for 5 years, for researchers with a PhD (or equivalent) and generally no more than 3 years of postdoc experience. Important: the administering organisation must be in the UK, Republic of Ireland or an LMIC (excluding India and mainland China), and from 29 Oct 2026 only the UK and LMICs in Africa, South Asia and South-East Asia, so Utrecht-based researchers are not eligible.

name: Clinical Trial Program – Cardiovascular Clinical Trials
themes: Clinical trials & drug development; Drug safety & pharmacovigilance; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence
partnersNote: Co-financing: Hartstichting co-funds multicentre investigator-initiated trials and requires at least one other funder
summary: The Hartstichting Klinische Studie Programma co-funds national or international multicentre, investigator-initiated cardiovascular clinical trials. It speeds up the step from positive early trials to better care, and at least one other funder must also contribute. A pre-application can be submitted at any time and is assessed within about three weeks; if approved, a full application follows at fixed deadlines, of which there are 2-3 per year. The 2025 dates were 25 Feb, 8 Apr and 16 Sep 2025 (14:00), and no 2026/2027 full-application dates are published. The page states no budget ceiling or maximum duration.

name: Wellcome Discovery Awards – Always-Open (rolling)
themes: Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence; Clinical pharmacology & therapeutics; Global health; Sustainable pharmacy & planetary health
summary: Since 22-23 September 2026, Wellcome Discovery Awards are always open with no submission deadlines, replacing the fixed rounds; the deadlines page lists a July 2027 interview round. The award supports established researchers and teams doing bold discovery research on human life, health and wellbeing, with an average of about GBP 3.5M (over GBP 5M gets extra scrutiny) for up to 8 years. Lead applicants need a permanent or long-term contract at an administering organisation in the UK, Republic of Ireland or an LMIC (excluding India and mainland China); from 29 Oct 2026 only the UK and LMICs in Africa, South Asia and South-East Asia qualify. Utrecht researchers can only join as coapplicants, who may be based anywhere except mainland China.

name: GCRFF Multinational Clinical Trials Initiative – 2027 EOI rounds
themes: Clinical trials & drug development; Pharmacoepidemiology & real-world evidence
partnersNote: Multinational consortium across GCRFF partner countries; Hartstichting seeks co-funders
summary: Expression-of-interest route through which cardiovascular research funders of the Global Cardiovascular Research Funders Forum co-fund large multinational clinical trials; Dutch applicants first consult the Hartstichting and submit a pre-application form, then an EOI via the BHF grants system. Hartstichting lists it as continuously open with two rounds per year (2025 rounds: 23 May and 26 Sep); 2027 round dates are not published.

name: Netwerkactiviteitenregeling (network events funding)
themes: Valorisation & public-private; Education & training
partnersNote: Substantial SME participation and co-funding from other parties required.
summary: Contributes to the third-party costs (such as venue and catering) of national or international events that connect researchers, companies, care professionals and investors in the Dutch life sciences and health sector. Events must involve SMEs substantially, fit the Health & Care missions and have other co-funders; flights and hotels are not covered. Applications go in at least four months before the event, and a committee reviews them every two weeks.

name: ERDERA Networking Support Scheme (rare disease networking events)
careerStages: PhD; Postdoc; Early career; Mid career; Senior/PI
themes: Rare diseases & orphan drugs
partnersNote: 3–10 co-applicants from at least 3 ERDERA countries, at least one from an underrepresented country.
summary: Funds transnational networking events, in person or hybrid, on rare diseases or rare cancers, bringing together researchers, clinicians and patient organisations. It pays up to €30,000 per event, including participants' travel and accommodation. Groups of 3–10 co-applicants from at least three countries apply, including at least one from an underrepresented country. Rounds are collected every six months while funds last (expected until April 2029), but the page does not give the next collection date.

name: Alzheimer Nederland Small Grants (research internship abroad, thesis printing, conference attendance)
themes: Open (any discipline)
summary: Year-round small grants from Alzheimer Nederland for an international research internship, PhD thesis printing costs, or conference attendance; apply via the AIMS portal at least 4 weeks before needed. Amounts and detailed eligibility are in the portal.
